summary: Publish the ChatGPT adapter Nix package as fractal-chatgpt with the st-chatgpt bridge

replay.detail: No graph replay or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: packages.fractal-chatgpt is canonical. packages.st-chatgpt selects the same derivation, and bin/st-chatgpt is a symlink to fractal-chatgpt. The Cargo st-chatgpt target remains. Source exercises that launch the adapter select fractal-chatgpt.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: New Nix consumers can select fractal-chatgpt. Existing st-chatgpt package and executable consumers continue to work. The prototype exercise builds and launches fractal-chatgpt.

recovery.detail: No persistent data is changed. The retained package attribute and executable symlink continue to invoke the same adapter.
